components.name: Search Field
components.description: Compact global search with an authored icon, quiet shortcut hint, violet caret, and border-led focus.
components.css: .ds-search { align-items: center; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 5px; color: var(--text-muted); display: flex; height: 34px; max-width: 420px; padding: 0 9px; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-search-icon { fill: none; height: 17px; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.5; width: 17px; } .ds-search input { background: transparent; border: 0; caret-color: var(--accent-muted); color: var(--text); font: 13px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; height: 100%; min-width: 0; outline: 0; padding: 0 8px; width: 100%; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); opacity: 1; } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-muted); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-key { border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 3px; color: var(--text-muted); font: 10px/18px ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; padding: 0 5px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: A compact active destination with raised graphite, one hairline, an authored icon, and a tabular count.
components.css: .ds-nav { align-items: center; background: var(--surface-raised); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 5px; color: var(--text); display: grid; font: 13px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 9px; text-align: left; width: 166px; } .ds-nav:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); } .ds-nav:active { background: var(--surface); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-muted); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-icon { color: var(--accent-muted); fill: none; height: 17px; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.5; width: 17px; } .ds-nav-count { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-graph { background: var(--canvas); color: var(--text-secondary); display: block; font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; height: 180px; width: 360px; } .ds-edge { stroke: #555b65; stroke-dasharray: 2 5; stroke-width: .9; transition: opacity 160ms ease, stroke 160ms ease; } .ds-edge-active { opacity: .95; stroke: var(--accent-muted); stroke-width: 1.35; } .ds-edge-dim { opacity: .28; } .ds-node { cursor: pointer; outline: none; } .ds-node circle { fill: #282442; stroke: var(--accent); stroke-width: 2.4; } .ds-node text { fill: var(--text); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-anchor: middle; } .ds-node:hover circle { fill: #352f59; stroke: var(--accent-muted); } .ds-node:active circle { fill: #211e37; } .ds-node:focus-visible circle { stroke: var(--accent-muted); stroke-width: 3; } .ds-memory circle { fill: #89919e; stroke: var(--text); stroke-width: 1; } .ds-memory text { fill: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 11px; } .ds-memory.ds-conflict circle { fill: #271719; stroke: var(--danger); stroke-width: 1.5; }

narrative.overview:
MegaBrain Home is direct visual access to the owner's knowledge, not a dashboard that summarizes it. The graph replaces hero copy, stat cards, and presentation framing: show the whole knowledge shape first, isolate direct relationships on selection, reveal evidence and history in the inspector, then provide a quiet path to immutable Markdown.

The atmosphere is precise, calm, compact, and confidence-inspiring. Warm graphite chrome recedes around the knowledge map. Violet identifies selection and current attention; coral preserves the visibility of conflict. Every surface should make ownership, provenance, uncertainty, and snapshot freshness legible without forcing the owner to learn repository mechanics.
keyCharacteristics: Graph-first desktop composition with receding navigation and persistent evidence.
Compact neutral typography, exact spacing, and 1px graphite hairlines.
A whole shape → evidence → Markdown interaction path.
Violet selection, coral conflict, and explicit text for every meaningful state.
A ranked topic list on mobile, not a compressed graph.

rules.name: The Selection Is Signal Rule
rules.body: Violet marks the current point of attention and current knowledge. It is not decoration.

rules.name: The Conflict Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Coral is reserved for unresolved conflict and danger states, always paired with explicit text.

rules.name: The Density Must Stay Legible Rule
rules.body: Compact type may reduce size only when hierarchy, contrast, and line height preserve scanning.

rules.name: The Whole Shape First Rule
rules.body: Desktop opens on the graph; evidence follows selection in the persistent inspector.

rules.name: The Flat Instrument Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay flat. Use tonal separation and 1px hairlines to establish hierarchy; do not add shadows.

rules.name: The Curve Is Restraint Rule
rules.body: Use 3–5px corners for controls and containers; reserve circles for graph and status semantics.

rules.name: The Evidence Path Rule
rules.body: Every selection should lead from shape to evidence to immutable Markdown.

dos: Do let the knowledge graph dominate the desktop overview and let surrounding chrome recede.
Do use violet for selection, focus, and current evidence; use coral only for conflict and danger.
Do preserve provenance, history, uncertainty, and snapshot freshness in plain language.
Do pair color-coded states with labels, maintain visible keyboard focus, and honor reduced motion.
Do replace the graph with a ranked topic list on narrow screens while preserving selection and evidence.
donts: Don't turn MegaBrain Home into a hero page, KPI dashboard, bento grid, or collection of large stat cards.
Don't add gradients, glassmorphism, glow, neon, shadows, decorative illustration, or presentation theater.
Don't use an anatomical brain, neural-network cliché, person, or physical knowledge metaphor.
Don't round every element into pills or soften the compact 3–5px form language.
Don't hide conflicts, provenance, immutable Markdown access, or the local snapshot boundary.
Don't imply that a generated local snapshot is continuously synchronized.
